snippet.title: CrimeBot - Detective Game
snippet.description:
*** Detective CrimeBot - Criminal Case ***
Who is the killer ? Can you solve a murder using only your detective instinct?
Good luck with your detective investigations in this detective game!
Get it on Android: https://goo.gl/aQX9aN
Get it on iOS: https://goo.gl/UAhQs3
Get it on Windows 10: https://goo.gl/5orj7s
